Senses.Explanation: The presiding teacher uses “lost out today” as a public score of his own handling of the encounter. Caoshan repeats it after the questioning participant asks the assembly to remember his answer; Jingqing says it when a newcomer challenges his whisk. Guanxi drops his staff and declares the loss after the questioning participant calls him blind, while other masters use the same score when no one answers.
